title: 2.1.11 Nest a Check
description: Write an if statement inside another if statement to ask a follow-up question. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: composition of book 2.1.1 'The if Statement' and 2.1.3 'The else Clause'; curriculum-plan §2.1 Topics: Nested conditionals

steps.title: Declare two variables
steps.instructions: Create a variable called isLoggedIn (true or false) and a variable called isAdmin (true or false).

steps.title: Nest the admin check inside the login check
steps.instructions: Write an outer if that checks isLoggedIn. Inside that block, write a nested if / else that checks isAdmin: log 'Welcome, admin.' if true, log 'Welcome, user.' if false. Add an outer else that logs 'Please log in.'

requirements.title: isAdmin check nested inside isLoggedIn, logs admin message
requirements.description: if (isLoggedIn) nests an if (isAdmin) whose block logs a message about admin

requirements.title: isAdmin's else logs user message
requirements.description: the else paired with if (isAdmin) logs a message about user

requirements.title: outer else logs please log in
requirements.description: the outer else (paired with isLoggedIn) logs a message containing 'log in'
